name: MC Beauty Nails
owner_source: Florida Sunbiz corporate filing P18000078667 (mirrored via bisprofiles.com/opencorporates), lists Maday Castillo as President and registered agent, incorporated 2018-09-17. Independently confirmed as the working nail tech: Google/Birdeye reviews repeatedly name 'Maday' as the technician, and a Yelp Q&A answer to a pricing question is signed 'Maday C.'. Also matches the Instagram handle given (madaycastillo0926), whose public photo alt text reads 'Photo by Maday Castillo' on every post fetched.
founded_source: Sunbiz/bisprofiles incorporation date for MC Beauty Nails Corp (2018-09-17). Used as the 'open since' year on the site; the storefront may predate or postdate the corp filing slightly, not independently confirmed beyond the filing.
address_source: Majority/independent-source address, used on the site. Confirmed consistently across Birdeye (explicitly sourced from Google), Waze, Atly, Loc8NearMe and belliata.com, all citing '8631 Coral Way / Coral Wy suite 104, Miami, FL 33155'. This matches the address supplied in the original assignment brief.
address_discrepancy_note: IMPORTANT, documented for transparency: three sources disagree on the exact address, and none could be independently verified against a live Google Maps fetch (JS-rendered, unreachable). (1) Booksy's own business profile JSON-LD (booksy.com/en-us/174293...) self-reports 'Coral Wy' but as '8563 Coral Wy, Miami, 33155' (no suite), a different house number than the majority sources; possible typo by the owner when setting up Booksy, or the majority sources could be wrong. (2) Yelp's listing for 'MC BEAUTY NAILS' (yelp.com/biz/mc-beauty-nails-miami, 21 reviews, distinct from the 85 Google/46 Booksy counts) shows a different address entirely, '1076 SW 67th, Miami, FL 33144', several miles away near a salon-suite building ('Mia Salon Suite' at 8th St & 67th Ave); this may be Yelp mismatching a different small tenant business to the same name, or an earlier/different location. (3) Loc8NearMe separately flags the 8631 Coral Way listing as 'closed'. Given the phone number (786) 468-3364 is identical and consistent across every single source including Booksy, Birdeye, belliata, and the Yelp Q&A signed 'Maday C.', this is confidently the same business/technician throughout; only the exact storefront address has conflicting evidence. Went with the majority-sourced 8631 Coral Way, Suite 104 for the JSON-LD, map embed and footer, since it is corroborated by the most independent sources and matches the original brief, but this should be verified with a phone call before real outreach claims a precise address.
phone_source: Identical across every source found: Booksy Q&A answer signed 'Maday C.', belliata.com, general web search snippets, and the original assignment brief. High confidence.
rating_source: reviews.birdeye.com/mc-beauty-nails-170205810484119, which explicitly labels its aggregate as sourced from 'Google' (5.0 stars, 85 reviews). Used as the primary/headline figure per PIPELINE guidance (Google is the backbone; Birdeye is an acceptable secondary source when it explicitly cites Google and Google Maps itself is unreachable via WebFetch/curl in this environment).
rating_secondary: Booksy's own booking page (booksy.com/en-us/174293_mc-beauty-nails_nail-salon_15889_miami) shows a separate, lower tally in its JSON-LD: aggregateRating 4.891 (rounds to 4.9) on 46 reviews. This is Booksy-only review volume, smaller and independent from the Google total; not used as the headline figure (Google is more authoritative and has 85 vs 46), but corroborates a genuinely excellent, high, consistent rating from two independent review pools.
hours_source: Consistent across Birdeye, Booksy's live page, and general search snippets: Monday-Saturday 9:00am-6:00pm, Sunday closed. No conflicting hours found anywhere.
services_source: Full menu with real prices and durations fetched directly from the live Booksy booking page (booksy.com/en-us/174293_mc-beauty-nails_nail-salon_15889_miami), which was fetchable and rendered the actual service list. 19 services found; 4 were selected for the site's featured service cards (Gel Manicure & Gel Pedicure combo, Acrylic Full Set, Apres, Dip Powder), representing the range from signature combo to trending technique to everyday care. All service names, prices and durations used on the site are exact matches to this Booksy data, unmodified.
ig_note: Public profile, belongs to the owner/technician Maday Castillo (personal-style handle, not a dedicated business account, common for solo nail techs). scripts/ig_photos.py (Railway ig-photo-service) returned 12 real photos, all with alt text 'Photo by Maday Castillo on <date>', dates ranging 2018-2019 (the account's public post history visible to the service). Direct IG bio/follower-count fetch (web_profile_info API and WebFetch of instagram.com) was blocked/rate-limited (401/429) on every attempt from this environment; scripts/ig_contact.py's local Playwright fallback is unavailable in this sandbox (no .venv-pw, no residential IP), so bio text and IG business_email could not be retrieved. Photos themselves downloaded successfully via the Railway service, which is IP-independent from the sandbox's egress restriction.
website_note: All 7 domain variants tested return DNS NXDOMAIN (confirmed both via curl -I, which failed to resolve/exit code 6, and via getent hosts). No parked or for-sale pages found, the domains are simply unregistered. Also checked mcnailsandbeauty.com, which DOES resolve (Squarespace site, 200 OK) but on inspection is a completely unrelated nail salon called 'MC Nail & Beauty' at 850 Long Island Ave, Deer Park, NY 11729 (phone (631) 243-3106, email Mcnailspa850@gmail.com), no connection to this Miami business beyond a similar initials-based name. Also checked mcnails.netlify.app ('MC Nails, A Place to Relax'), a generic template/portfolio site with no address, phone, or content matching MC Beauty Nails Westchester in any way; even if it were related, a netlify.app subdomain does not count as an owned domain per pipeline rules. Conclusion: has_own_site is confidently false.

General web search for 'MC Beauty Nails Maday Castillo email contact Miami': no email surfaced in any result

Aggregator listings (Loc8NearMe, Atly, belliata.com, ivof.com, cityof.com): none publish an email field for this business

brand_vibe: Boutique nail salon in a small Westchester storefront on Coral Way. No interior/storefront photos were publicly available (owner's IG feed and Booksy gallery are entirely close-up hand/nail shots, no salon photos found), so the site's visual identity leans on the manicure and pedicure work itself: glossy reds, soft mauves, wine and berry tones, occasional pastel (mint, sky blue). Built on light-v2 with hue 348 (deep rosewood/berry, sat_mult 1.0, light_mult 0.97), chosen to sit inside the assignment's suggested 335-350 rose/berry range while landing visibly more red/wine (#9b4858/#59202f accent tones) than liquidglamournails, the other Westchester-area Miami nail salon already in the registry, whose palette is a brighter magenta-pink (#b3236e/#e0568f, hue ~328-331).
photos_source: scripts/ig_photos.py against @madaycastillo0926 via the Railway ig-photo-service, 12 photos returned (all verified real JPEG >15KB with `file`). VISUAL CURATION (every photo opened and inspected individually, not chosen by filename): 10 of the 12 IG photos carry a self-added 'MC Beauty Nails' + phone-number text watermark burned into the image (common self-promo habit for small nail techs posting to Instagram), or a busy decorative frame/background template (floral borders, green swirl pattern, ornamental corner graphic); these were EXCLUDED from the gallery/hero per the no-burned-in-text/no-clutter curation rule, even though the manicures themselves were often well done. Only 1 of the 12 IG photos (a clean light-blue gel manicure, no watermark, no frame) was clean enough to use; saved as nail-9.jpg. To reach a full gallery, the live Booksy business page's review_photos (customer-submitted photos attached to real Booksy reviews, fetched directly via curl at their full uploaded resolution, e.g. 810x1080 or 2340x1755, not the default 100x100/250x250 thumbnail crop Booksy serves by default) were inspected: 8 of these were clean, unwatermarked, well-lit, finished-result shots and were used (nail-1.jpg through nail-8.jpg). Total: 9 real, curated, watermark-free photos used across hero/about/gallery, well above the 5-photo minimum. No owner selfies exist in any source found, so no dedicated 'about' avatar photo was available; per the black-pelican-tattoo-boca precedent, a strong nail-art photo (nail-1.jpg) was reused as both the small circular logo/avatar and the hero image rather than fabricating or omitting them.
language_source: Primary language determined from real evidence, not assumed: of 5 verbatim Google reviews found, 3 are in Spanish and 2 in English (a bilingual but Spanish-leaning client base, consistent with Westchester's demographics). The real Booksy service menu itself mixes English and Spanish service names with a Spanish-leaning tilt on several core listings ('Gel de construccion', 'Manicura pedicure regular', 'Pedicure con masaje', 'Remover dip', 'Dip con extension', 'Acrilico full set'). Set language: es as the site default, with a full English translation available via the toggle.
